findings.place: Relation (12), four-sided frame around the three underbraced factors and =1
findings.ink: The upper, right, lower and left frame strokes are distinct. White paper separates their endpoints at every corner: the left side begins below the upper stroke, the right side begins below and to the right of the upper endpoint, and both side strokes stop short of the lower stroke. The upper and lower runs rise slightly to the right. Both supplied witnesses use a closed \boxed frame. The replacement preserves four separate strokes; it makes no change to the enclosed factors, exponents, underbraces or equality. Main independently confirmed all four corner gaps in the same existing crop.

notes: The independent reading adds one graphic correction: the frame around relation (12) has four open corners, now represented by four separate TikZ strokes. A targeted reuse of the existing relation crop confirms the middle closing parenthesis: its convex return immediately to the right of the infinity is separable from the following a’s lower contour despite their upper overlap, so the accepted mathematical text is retained without a new doubt. The opening detached upright, the ambiguous middle variant dot/star, the fragment below the dash, the analytic parenthesis, the two uncertain triangle details, and the final family delimiter remain as the seven listed doubts. In the sommet correction, the long horizontal stroke belongs to the cancellation through point; no separate insertion leader can be isolated. The triangle’s opposed inner heads, rising continuation, outer directions and existing gaps agree with the accepted drawing. The last family label retains i,j, and the reference (17) is kept as written. No source-mark decision changes. No algebraic proof or cross-page consistency check was performed; reading the displayed relation is not counted as a mathematical check.
